# Contribution boundary fallback

**Fallback policy `[owner: copilot-extensions-harness@0.1.0-dev38]`:** copilot-extensions accepts only general-purpose, organization-neutral capabilities; personal needs belong in the adopter's private control repo and organization-specific work in its internal marketplace. Invoke the `contributing-to-copilot-extensions` skill for the complete contribution ground rules and flow.
